bio:
Short Path is a visualiser for shortest-path algorithms, including Dijkstra and the Duan-Mao approach, so you can watch how each one explores a graph and why they reach the answer differently.

One page, no install, written in vanilla JavaScript. By Tront (Trent Sterling).
title: Short Path by Tront
list:
• VibeStar: A* pathfinding visualiser with web workers and a lot of knobs.
  • VibeMaze: ASCII 3D maze rendered with a triangle rasteriser, grown out of an ASCII raycaster.
  • Frame-Rate Independent Lerp: Why naive lerp smoothing breaks at different frame rates, and the fix.
